definition: Information-engineering factory that transforms input information into a verified project/product.

workshops.name: ANALYSIS
workshops.purpose: Transform raw information into requirements, facts, risks and traceability.

workshops.name: ARCHITECTURE
workshops.purpose: Transform validated requirements into architecture and Development Pack.

workshops.name: KNOWLEDGE_DATA
workshops.purpose: Prepare governed knowledge, data, datasets and contracts.

workshops.name: AGENT_COMPONENT_ENGINEERING
workshops.purpose: Select REUSE/ADAPT/NEW components, Agent Kits, models and tools.

workshops.name: QA_SECURITY_LAB
workshops.purpose: Independently prove functional, quality and security properties.

workshops.name: DEVOPS_ENVIRONMENTS
workshops.purpose: Build, package, deploy and operate with evidence.

workshops.name: ACCEPTANCE_CERTIFICATION
workshops.purpose: Evaluate full evidence bundle and authorize promotion.

workshops.name: OUTPUT_DELIVERY
workshops.purpose: Deliver product plus complete controlled technical dossier.

role_rule: Agents are workers/equipment inside workshops; they are not the factory.
c00_c99_rule: C00-C99 indexes controlled product dossier areas; workshops may consume/produce multiple Cxx artifacts.
